categories.name: 构图 / 版式

collections.summary: 结合构图、色彩、信息模块与特效的整套 AI Prompt 骨架，强调生活方式街拍与高端街头氛围。

pillars.label: 视觉结构
items: 双主体叙事构图 + 60/40 杂志版式 + 居中主视觉
画面与右侧工具栏信息并行

pillars.label: 色彩策略
items: 高级中性色底 + 暖冷对比强调
色卡区展示 HEX/Pantone

pillars.label: 内容布局
items: OOTD 模块 + 单品拆解卡片 + 幽灵模特
情绪/场景标签与图标提示

pillars.label: 特效层
items: 偏移印刷 + 半色调网点 + 胶片黑边
局部模糊 vs 清晰对比塑造层次

prompt: 构图：twin-subject narrative, 60/40 split editorial layout, centered hero with lifestyle image + utility sidebar, generous negative space with layered collage + rule-of-thirds framing.
色彩：muted neutral base, accent warm/cool contrast, dedicated swatch strip with HEX labels, desaturated background with bright subject.
信息：OOTD module, item breakdown cards, ghost mannequin callouts, right-side toolbar info flow, icon + text mood tags.
质感与特效：paper texture base, matte vs glossy contrast, offset print misregistration, halftone dots, film frame edge, selective blur vs sharp detail.
